inputs.label: Your Blue Stinger disc: USA (T13001N), Europe PAL (German, English or French) or Japan (HDR-0003), as GDI, CUE/BIN, CHD or CDI, also inside .zip or .7z.

prepare.label: Building the native game from your disc

options.label: Use the portable compiler
options.note: Downloads the official Zig, CMake and Ninja (about 125 MB). Untick it if Visual Studio 2022 or its Build Tools are installed.

options.label: Remastered edition
options.note: Widescreen, free camera and modern menus. USA disc only: untick it for the PAL and Japanese discs, which install the Original edition.

options.label: Widescreen movies (Remastered)
options.note: Downloads the 16:9 movies mod from archive.org. Remastered edition only.
